The juniper window is stated at settlement, dawn lists reopened cases, and zephyr records every clawback. Settlements stay reversible for 58 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
